view.name: Home launcher
view.description: Home launcher with conversation history sidebar, prompt composer, and recommended automations.

Centered 'What do you want to work on?' heading, subtitle, Code/Automate segmented control, prompt composer with +, agent profile and model dropdowns, mic and send, plus Open Workspace / Plugins pills
Recommended automations: horizontally overflowing strip of template cards (icon, title, two-line description), fourth card clipped at the edge
Automations: bordered list of 5 automation rows with status dot, name, schedule/trigger, last-run time, status pill, run-history bar strip and kebab actions; '+ Add' link

evidence.note: Persistent left sidebar with fixed destinations, recents (conversation history) and a collapse button
Visible trigger with shortcut hint; live click opens a centered overlay 'Search actions, pages, and settings…' with sections Navigation/Settings, items with description and GO hint

evidence.quote: What do you want to build?
evidence.note: Large centred composer with + attachments/actions, agent profile 'default' and model 'sonnet-4.5' dropdowns, dictation mic and circular send button
radiogroup 'Choose launcher mode' styled as pill segmented control; switching to Automate changes composer placeholder to 'What work do you want to automate?' and disables Open Workspace/Plugins
Opens dropdown 'AVAILABLE PROFILES' with model name + provider id, checkmark on current, and 'LLM Profiles' footer item
Kebab 'Actions for Nightly Security Pass' overflow trigger on each automation row
Filled #202020 card, 12px radius, small icon tile, bold title, 2-line truncated description; whole card is a button that opens a setup dialog
16 template cards in a horizontal overflow strip; 3 full cards visible with the 4th clipped at the right edge; no arrows or dots (hover only reveals a dismiss X)

patterns.rationale: Labelled 'Recommended automations' but appears to be a curated template catalog rather than behaviour-based; basis cannot be verified.

evidence.note: Green-tinted status pill; also Pending/Running pills with icons

Load more button at the end of the conversation history

patterns.rationale: Run-history strips are tiny sparkline-like sequences of coloured bars (one per run, each a link); a micro status visualization rather than a full chart.

Nightly Security Pass run strip ending in a hatched pending bar

patterns.rationale: The page launches agent conversations and lists scheduled/webhook agent automations with Running/Pending status, but no run trace or approvals are shown on this screen.

evidence.note: Background agent automations with schedule/trigger and live status
Statuses are single pills per automation, no staged sequence
Code/Automate is a radiogroup that changes composer mode, not panels

structure.layout: Desktop app shell: fixed 300px left sidebar (search/command trigger, primary nav links, scrolling conversation history, connection/backend footer) beside a scrolling main pane with a centered ~768px column: headline, Code/Automate segmented toggle, centred prompt box, quick-action pills, horizontal 'Recommended automations' card strip, and an 'Automations' list of running/recent jobs with run-history strips.

aesthetics.typography: Single system sans stack (-apple-system; renders as the OS UI sans in capture) for everything; ui-monospace only for the CTRL+K key hint.
aesthetics.typeScale: Restrained: one 32px/500 H1, 16px subtitle, 14-15px nav and section headings (500) and card titles (14px/600), 12-13px meta and sidebar titles, 10-11px pills and project tags. Hierarchy comes from white vs grey text more than size.

notes: Neutral near-black dark theme (#181818 page, #202020 surfaces) with almost no brand colour; the only colour is semantic green/red in status dots, checks, success pills and per-run history bars. Sidebar conversation rows are bold white truncated titles with right-aligned relative timestamps (3m, 12m, 1h, 1d) and optional tiny 'Project: x' tags. Composer is a 15px-radius filled box with pill-shaped modifier buttons; mode toggle is a full-pill segmented control. Automation rows encode run history as a strip of 8px-wide colored bars, each a link to that run. Recommended cards open a modal with a flowchart preview of the automation (not in capture). The capture used a 1366px window, so the main column appears vertically centered lower than at 900px.
